snippet.title: Deserter—Official Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3248910/Deserter/
An immersive isometric stealth RPG about a thief surviving in a decaying totalitarian city. Plan every move, evade traps, and pull off daring heists right under the Party's nose.

Coming 2026 - Wishlist now
